evidence.title: Lykos Therapeutics Announces Complete Response Letter for Midomafetamine Capsules for PTSD
FDA Briefing Document, NDA 215455 midomafetamine, Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee Meeting

previous.note: The FDA complete response letter for NDA 215455 names functional unblinding as part of the basis for not accepting the efficacy results. Deficiency 3 says prior midomafetamine use made participants 'more likely to recognize the effects of midomafetamine (i.e., leading to functional unblinding) and anticipate a treatment benefit', and concludes: 'These limitations impact the interpretability of MAPP1 and MAPP2 and, together with failure of MPLONG to provide evidence of a durable treatment effect, preclude the ability to establish substantial evidence of effectiveness.' Date is the issue date the sponsor disclosed; the letter's electronic signature reads 08/08/2024. The 2024-06-04 advisory committee briefing document already called functional unblinding a problem for interpreting efficacy, but stopped short of a deficiency finding.
